final: WITH j AS (SELECT s.telescref AS t, o.weathprofile AS w, s.modindex AS m, s.phaseshiftdeg AS p FROM signals s JOIN telescopes te ON s.telescref = te.telescregistry JOIN observatories o ON te.observstation = o.observstation), g AS (SELECT t, w, AVG(m) AS am, AVG(p) AS ap FROM j GROUP BY t, w), ov AS (SELECT AVG(m) AS oa FROM j) SELECT w AS weathprofile, AVG(am) AS avg_modindex, AVG(ap) AS avg_phaseshift, AVG(am - (SELECT oa FROM ov)) AS avg_excess_over_overall FROM g WHERE am > (SELECT oa FROM ov) GROUP BY w
